summary: Orange DAO Fellowship is a real crypto/web3 accelerator, but the public application pages found on 2026-06-09 reference past W25/S25/W26 cohorts, with W26 starting in early January 2026. No current or future cohort deadline was published, so no event should be merged yet.

sources.title: Orange DAO
sources.supports: Official site describes the Orange DAO Fellowship as a 12-week crypto company-building program with $100K uncapped SAFE funding, 2% advisory fee, mentorship, investor demo day access, and hybrid format language.

sources.title: Orange Winter 26 Early Application Form
sources.supports: Official application form says Orange Winter 2026 starts early January 2026, lasts 12 weeks, offers USD $100,000 funding, and culminates with Demo Day.

sources.title: Orange Fellowship Summer S25 Late Application Form
sources.supports: Official application form says the Summer 2025 late application deadline was June 1 and the S25 batch started in July 2025, confirming available application pages are stale as of 2026-06-09.

notes: Did not create proposed_event because all specific cohort dates found are before 2026-06-09.
If Orange DAO opens a Summer/Fall 2026 or Winter 2027 application page, this accelerator should be rechecked and merged as a web3 accelerator with funding, mentorship, and resources support.

Likely taxonomy if current dates appear: types accelerator/program; supports funding/mentorship/resources; sector web3; location hybrid with San Francisco IRL segments if the future source repeats the current FAQ language.
